concept: Solana perp venue landscape and status of Drift Velocity Zeta Flash
summary: Source-anchored research for Solana perp venue landscape and status of Drift Velocity Zeta Flash. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: Drift's stated relaunch hardening responds directly to the exploit: a new program at a fresh address with fully rotated keys; durable nonces disabled for all signers; timelocks on critical admin actions with real-time alerts; dedicated signing devices with transaction content verified outside the primary signing interface; a new community-governed multisig for core assets; mandatory instruction-level audits before mainnet; independent review by OtterSec and Asymmetric Research plus the Solana Foundation STRIDE program; USDT as primary collateral and settlement stablecoin; narrowed markets; and removal of Earn products (Isolated Markets, Amplify) with Prop AMM and mobile-app timelines under review. (medium confidence)

Zeta Markets, which started as an on-chain order-book perps DEX on Solana, sunset its original product in May 2025. The Zeta Foundation's welcome page says 'In May 2025 Zeta Protocol will cease operations' and cites over $15B of lifetime volume and 40k+ monthly active users; its later wind-down notice says 'The Zeta platform was sunset over a year ago in May 2025'; Solana Compass says Zeta shut its original L1 product in May 2025 to redirect resources to Bullet. (high confidence)
